headline: Swords of Revealing Light
title: Swords of Revealing Light Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Swords of Revealing Light. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card that stays on the field. What does it do? It flips your opponent's face-down monsters face-up, and while it is on the field their monsters cannot declare an attack. It is destroyed in the End Phase of your opponent's third turn. How do you use it? Use it to buy time when you are behind, while you set up your own win. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
